title: SWR
description: A React hooks library for remote data fetching by Vercel.

data.text: SWR (stale-while-revalidate) is a lightweight React hooks library for remote data fetching created by Vercel. It implements the stale-while-revalidate caching strategy, returning cached data immediately while revalidating in the background.

data.title: Fetching with SWR
data.content: Use the useSWR hook to fetch and cache profile data.

terms.definition: An HTTP cache strategy that serves cached content while updating the cache in the background.
Merging multiple requests with the same key into a single network request.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Built-in caching, revalidation, and focus tracking
data.takeaway: SWR provides a simple, performant way to fetch and cache remote data in React.
